title: A component keeps its name where a screen keeps its name
goal: A screen promoted to a component shows the component name above its top left corner instead of the screen name. Clicking a screen name renames it on the spot, but clicking a component name there does nothing: it can only be renamed in the Component section of the dock. Make the two names behave the same.
notes: Frame names landed 2026-09-03 (FrameNameLabels in PhotonzCore, CanvasFrames.swift). The component mark is drawn by CanvasComponents.refreshComponentChrome as a glyph plus a CATextLayer, offset right of the glyph, so its hit box starts at rect.minX + glyph + 4 rather than rect.minX. Rename goes through EditorState.renameComponent (not renameLayer), which is what keeps instances and the tile in step.
acceptance: Clicking a component name on the canvas selects that component
Double clicking it opens it for typing in place, with the whole name selected
Return lands the new name as one undo step and Escape leaves it as it was
The name matches everywhere at once: the canvas, the Layers list, the Library tile and the Component section
